name: core
description: Universal core: router, plan, review, verify, done, improve; ECC planning, review and quality skills and agents.

patches.search:
# Reinstall dependencies
rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install

# Fix ESLint auto-fixable
npx eslint . --fix
patches.replace: # Never delete the lock file or run a repository-wide --fix: use the project's own lint command
patches.reason: deleting the lock file re-resolves every dependency; a repository-wide --fix rewrites unrelated files

excluded.rules/common/*: unscoped, always loaded; mandates an 80% coverage gate and conventional commits; points at global settings
excluded.agents/refactor-cleaner: runs unpinned npx tools the projects do not have
excluded.agents/performance-optimizer: runs unpinned npx tools and external audits
excluded.agents/docs-lookup: needs an MCP server the projects do not have
excluded.skills/orch-*, dev-team, team-builder: depend on agents and commands outside a subset
excluded.skills/documentation-lookup, council-mul: send content to external services or run unpinned remote code
